name: caotang-mcp
description: Serve a Caotang writing project to an MCP host: read it, and, when you allow it, change it.
long_description: Caotang's tools, resources and prompts over MCP, on stdio. The documents, notes and codex can be attached to a conversation as resources, and the prompts hand your assistant the context Caotang gathers for drafting a scene, filling a synopsis or checking continuity. The project stays in its folder on your computer, and the server makes no network connection. The project is read-only until you turn on "Allow changes" in this extension's settings. Then a write tool either asks you to confirm it in the host before it changes anything, or applies at once. Each tool's description says which.

project_folder.title: Project folder
project_folder.description: The Caotang project folder to serve. It must already hold a project.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes
allow_writes.description: Off by default, so the assistant can only read the project. Turn it on to let the assistant change the project. Some changes still ask you to confirm them first.
